instruction.text: Complete the sentence with the missing word.

atoms.a: Many people use a pseudonym to stay anonymous online.
atoms.b: Many people use a ((pseudonym)) to stay anonymous online.

atoms.a: I’d give the award to Amy, she showed so much perseverance in her training and completion of the marathon.
atoms.b: I’d give the award to Amy, she showed so much ((perseverance)) in her training and completion of the marathon.

atoms.a: Otherwise healthy adults usually recover well from pneumonia, but it can be dangerous for the very young or elderly.
atoms.b: Otherwise healthy adults usually recover well from ((pneumonia)), but it can be dangerous for the very young or elderly.

atoms.a: If someone has concerns about their mental health, it might be a good idea to see a psychiatrist.
atoms.b: If someone has concerns about their mental health, it might be a good idea to see a ((psychiatrist)).

atoms.a: While she enjoys a steak once in a while, she relies mostly on beans, tofu and poultry for protein.
atoms.b: While she enjoys a steak once in a while, she relies mostly on beans, tofu and poultry for ((protein)).
